svg.data-input-ac: 208/230 V single-phase (200-240 V), 16 A continuous (agency de-rated), 50/60 Hz
svg.data-capacity-scope: the load the PDU can hand on, 3.68 kW at 230 V and 3.33 kW at 208 V, 16 A in all (spec sheet); it is not what the PDU draws itself, which no document held states
svg.data-output-rating: 16 A total; 16 A per C19; 12 A (10 A CE) per C13
svg.data-breakers: two, one per load bank; rating and position not stated
svg.data-metering: load current in amps, total and per bank, on the digital ammeter and over the network
svg.data-network-interface: built-in LX Platform interface (pre-installed WEBCARDLX, PowerAlert Device Manager PADM20), 10/100 Mbps
svg.data-protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, SMTP, SNMPv1, SNMPv2, SNMPv3, telnet, SSH, FTP, DHCP, NTP
svg.data-certifications: EN 55022; EN 55024; CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 60950-1 (Canada); IEC 60950-1; NOM (Mexico); UL 60950-1
svg.data-product-compliance: RoHS; FCC Part 15 Class A (USA); Trade Agreements Act (TAA)

rect.data-description: the readout window, two seven-segment cells. It shows the load in amps, total or per bank, or the IP address two characters at a time; each cell's glyph set is on its digit.

g.data-description: the left digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
the right digit. Its states are the characters a seven-segment cell can form, each naming the segments it lights - a top, b top-right, c bottom-right, d bottom, e bottom-left, f top-left, g middle.
the left digit's decimal point, driven separately from the digit.
the right digit's decimal point, driven separately from the digit.
the Select / Rotate push button: pressed one second it scrolls the IP address, two seconds it turns the readout over (owner's manual 933666 rev B, Features).

the LX Platform interface status lamp (E): green steady in normal operation, a single flash at power-up, green and orange alternating while firmware updates (about once a second) or defaults restore (about twice a second)
g.title: status-led

g.data-description: USB-A for EnviroSense2 environmental modules (E2MT, E2MTDO, E2MTDI, E2MTHDI); not for a keyboard or mouse
g.title: usb

g.title: config

g.title: lan
